policy.effect_direction: signed original gene DESeq2 log2(cKO / WT)
policy.complex_rule: Every ligand AND every receptor complex subunit is an unambiguous DEG at its exact matching sender or receiver endpoint
policy.native_rank_rule: Original complete-universe LIANA scores and ranks are retained; no rank recomputation after DEG selection
policy.total_inhibitory_fit: Excluded because IN_Total is not one of the five requested endpoints

original_issue: The previous default used a logical OR: any matching ligand DEG OR receptor DEG. It admitted interactions with a non-DEG partner and populations outside C1/C6/C8. The new strict projection requires a logical AND across all complex subunits at both exact endpoints.

sign_interpretation.complex_mixed: Subunits have different signs; retain component-level signs without assigning one complex direction
sign_interpretation.opposite_directions: Ligand and receptor gene effects differ in sign; this is not a signed interaction-activity change
sign_interpretation.native_lr_logfc: Native source/target group-versus-rest specificity; NOT genotype fold change
sign_interpretation.genotype_interaction_test: Not fitted. Genotype interaction significance and up/down activity are not inferred.

c8_result: Calb1 is the sole saved C8 DEG (up in cKO); it is absent from mouseconsensus ligand/receptor subunits, so C8 has zero strict resource-supported interactions. This is not an omitted analysis or proof of no communication.
